cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?
